title: Tenant keys on Reference, corpus and reader models
description:
What: Reference, corpora and reader rows carry and enforce tenantId. Any new index follows the one-GSI-per-table-per-release rule, so the story plans its index across releases. Adopts legacy bare-id rows into the dedicated tenant (see existing PPY-109133 for the adoption pattern).
Acceptance:
Scenario: A query on tenant A's References returns only A's rows
  Given References in two tenants
  When tenant A lists by an index
  Then only A's rows return and no whole-table read happens

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented by PPY-94d609 (optional tenantId), PPY-ce6207 (knowledge keys), PPY-ef2c57 (reader and plugin keys, tables outside AppSync, vectors) and PPY-8f9462 (adoption of every model). Index plan: Reference needs NO new index for tenancy (corpus ids become tenant-unique, which makes feedStateKey, starFeedKey, mediumFeedKey, contentNeededKey and publicFeedKey tenant-safe; global values get a tenant prefix). Reference stays at 16 indexes with PR #1239.
